restaurant.name: Jinsol Gukbap
restaurant.tagline: Busan-Style Pork Soup & Korean Comfort Food
restaurant.description: Korean restaurant in Plano, TX serving Busan-style gukbap — rich pork bone soups simmered for over 24 hours, dwaeji gukbap, sundae gukbap, jjimdak, and more traditional Korean comfort food. Dine in or order online today!

restaurant.footer_description: Rich, slow-simmered Busan-style pork soups and traditional Korean comfort food.

contact.address_full: 111 W Spring Creek Pkwy Ste #102, Plano, TX 75023

home.ingredients_h2: Simmered 24 hours, true to Busan tradition
home.ingredients_body: At {{restaurant.name_short}}, every bowl of gukbap starts with a deep pork bone broth simmered for over 24 hours in cast-iron pots with an assortment of roots and vegetables. From dwaeji gukbap to sundae gukbap and hearty jjimdak, every dish is made with fresh ingredients and minimal oil — comforting Korean classics the way they're made in Busan.
